import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import io

# Data provided as a string
data = """Person ID,Gender,Age,Occupation,Sleep Duration,Quality of Sleep,Physical Activity Level,Stress Level,BMI Category,Blood Pressure,Heart Rate,Daily Steps,Sleep Disorder
1,Male,27,Software Engineer,6.1,6,42,6,Overweight,126/83,77,4200,
2,Male,28,Doctor,6.2,6,60,8,Normal,125/80,75,10000,
3,Male,28,Doctor,6.2,6,60,8,Normal,125/80,75,10000,
4,Male,28,Sales Representative,5.9,4,30,8,Obese,140/90,85,3000,Sleep Apnea
5,Male,28,Sales Representative,5.9,4,30,8,Obese,140/90,85,3000,Sleep Apnea
"""

# Read the data into a pandas DataFrame
df = pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(data))

# Fill NaN values in 'Sleep Disorder' for better categorical plotting
df['Sleep Disorder'] = df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None')

# Create a scatter plot to visualize the relationship between Sleep Duration and Quality of Sleep,
# colored by BMI Category and styled by Sleep Disorder.
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.scatterplot(
    data=df,
    x='Sleep Duration',
    y='Quality of Sleep',
    hue='BMI Category',         # Color points based on BMI category
    style='Sleep Disorder',     # Use different markers for sleep disorders
    s=200,                      # Set a fixed size for the points for clarity
    palette='viridis',          # Choose a color palette
    alpha=0.9                   # Set transparency for points
)

# Add title and labels for clarity
plt.title('Relationship Between Sleep Duration and Quality of Sleep', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10 scale)', fontsize=12)

# Add a grid for better readability
plt.grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.6)

# Improve legend placement to avoid overlapping with data points
plt.legend(title='Categories', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left', borderaxespad=0.)

# Adjust layout to prevent labels/legends from being cut off
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the plot to a file
plt.savefig('output.png')
